## Exercise 3
```{r ex3}
factors <- c("pH","Temp_C","RPM","Inoculum_pct","Sugar_gL")
low <- c(4,25,50,5,20); high <- c(6,35,200,15,60)
names(low) <- names(high) <- factors
df_coded <- df
for (f in factors) df_coded[[paste0(f,"_coded")]] <- 2*(df[[f]]-low[f])/(high[f]-low[f])-1

boot_ph <- numeric(1000)
for (b in 1:1000) {
  boot <- df_coded %>% slice_sample(n = nrow(df_coded), replace = TRUE)
  m <- lm(BC_yield_gL ~ pH_coded + Temp_C_coded + RPM_coded + Inoculum_pct_coded + Sugar_gL_coded +
    pH_coded:Temp_C_coded + Sugar_gL_coded:RPM_coded +
    I(pH_coded^2) + I(Temp_C_coded^2) + I(RPM_coded^2) + I(Inoculum_pct_coded^2) + I(Sugar_gL_coded^2), data = boot)
  bb <- coef(m); bl <- c(bb["pH_coded"],bb["Temp_C_coded"],bb["RPM_coded"],bb["Inoculum_pct_coded"],bb["Sugar_gL_coded"])
  bq <- c(bb["I(pH_coded^2)"],bb["I(Temp_C_coded^2)"],bb["I(RPM_coded^2)"],bb["I(Inoculum_pct_coded^2)"],bb["I(Sugar_gL_coded^2)"])
  AA <- diag(2*bq); AA[1,2] <- AA[2,1] <- bb["pH_coded:Temp_C_coded"]; AA[4,5] <- AA[5,4] <- bb["Sugar_gL_coded:RPM_coded"]
  xs <- -solve(AA, bl)/2
  boot_ph[b] <- low["pH"] + (xs[1]+1)*(high["pH"]-low["pH"])/2
}
cat(sprintf("Bootstrap pH: mean=%.3f, 95%% CI=[%.3f, %.3f]\n",
            mean(boot_ph), quantile(boot_ph, 0.025), quantile(boot_ph, 0.975)))
```
